text:
Rina: Ok team, confession: I started the Sticky Note Map. It began as a joke and now there's a tiny post-it country called 'Snackistan' on the whiteboard map. :roll_eyes:

Sam: Snackistan is sovereign territory. I declare free popcorn for all visitors. :popcorn:

Drew: Whoa. I put a tiny flag (straw) on Snackistan last week. It blew away during the meeting. Diplomatic incident.

Harper: Update: I've drawn a mountain range (the Great Memo Peaks) and a river (Paper Stream). This map is getting geopolitical.

Rina: The official anthem is a remix of elevator music. Also proposing passports: tiny sticky notes with people's snack preferences.

notifier-bot: Reminder set: Map maintenance every Wednesday 11:30.

Maya: I made a provisional passport for Eli: 'Allergies: none; Preferred snack: wasabi peas; Title: Grand Vizier of Dip.'

Sam: Passport stamping ceremony required. Who has a hole punch?

Drew: I do. Also proposing a border patrol: volunteers check that anyone crossing into Snackistan leaves a snack offering. 

Harper: border patrol volunteers: Sam, Rina, Maya. Uniform: one sticker.

Rina: Naming convention vote: Keep it silly. Options: Snackistan, Post-It Isles, Crumpland. Vote with reaction.

Maya: Voting now. Also adding a tiny legend: coffee shops = towns, plants = forests.

Sam: Vote tally: Snackistan x4, Post-It Isles x2, Crumpland x1. Winner declared.

notifier-bot: Snackistan is official. Announcement posted to #random.

Drew: I will be minister of cartography. My first act: add a tiny key for emergency cookie drops.

Harper: can we add an embassy for remote folks? A sticky with their name + timezone.

Rina: brilliant. Remote embassy idea accepted. Also please label the east coast as 'Bagel Bay' for obvious reasons.

Maya: Bagel Bay added. Also assigned tiny emojis to each region.

Sam: Passport ceremony scheduled Friday 4pm in the kitchen. Bring one snack to offer. Someone bring a kazoo for fanfare.

Drew: Kazoo procured. My kazoo is noble.

Rina: Great. Closing notes: treat the map with respect (no stapling). Long live Snackistan. :flag_white:
